title: Fake-DOM move: prompt-section-p0 / -run-quota / -runner-link onto loadWorld
description:
Plan piece 4, first half. These are the heaviest prompt-section suites by reads of fake internals: `-p0` has 14, `-run-quota` 14 and `-runner-link` 12. The plan lands piece 4 as one PR per two or three suites, so it is split into two subtasks.

Move `prompt-section-p0.test.js`, `prompt-section-run-quota.test.js` and `prompt-section-runner-link.test.js` onto `loadWorld`, using the idioms the prompt-section-go probe settled. `scrollTop`/`scrollHeight` on `-p0` and `-runner-link` are plain expandos on the container. A real element takes them, so they are not layout and do not stop the family. Any suite that repaints the run-change panel with a draft hits the `<select>.value` throw (review note 4). That is a stop for that suite, with the API named, not a client bug.

**Done when:** each moved suite has the same test names and counts, an assertion-map table with mutations, its findings classified, and its file off the census list. A suite that stops stays on the list, and the PR gives the reason.

---

**Where the scope and design live.** Parent: LIN-4255. Read its description's **Implementation Plan** (the approved plan) and the Plan Review Verdict comment `98a20bc0-f43b-406c-bb64-8ce22860b08f`, which has notes for the builder. The parent's approved plan is where this piece starts. Follow it. Where the code shows the plan is wrong, change course and say so in a comment on LIN-4255.

* Session fit: fits one session
* Plan-review due: no. Covered by LIN-4255's approving plan-review (comment 98a20bc0-f43b-406c-bb64-8ce22860b08f, rev 1).
* Grounding commit: `b5391736` (LinearViewer origin/main; still HEAD when this breakdown was made on 2026-11-05).

**Rules for every move piece (from the plan):** test names and counts stay the same. Before and after, run `node --test --test-reporter=spec <file>` and paste the empty diff. Remove each moved file from `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` and from the `fake-dom.js` header's consumer list in the same PR. Delete both copies, the container and the `vm` sandbox. Never loosen an assertion that reads fake internals: map it to a real-DOM replacement and prove the replacement goes red under the mutation it guards. Every red is a finding, and the PR records it as fixed, filed or fake artefact. Serializer differences (`disabled=""`, escaping) are fixed in the test's regexes, never by relaxing the fake. Out of scope: the 7 `container.querySelector ? … : null` guards in `public/prompt-section.js`.

---

## Implemented (close-out stub, 2026-11-05)

Implemented as approved in LIN-4255's plan, with no deviations: PR [https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2305](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2305>), squash-merged as `d537cd69` (head `6d91a37c`, CI green on that commit). The three suites (p0 58, run-quota 14, runner-link 13; names and counts unchanged) are on `loadWorld`, off `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` and in the `fake-dom.js` header consumer list. `public/` is untouched. This ticket's description had no embedded plan or research sections of its own (the plan lives in LIN-4255), so nothing was pruned; the full pre-close-out description is preserved in the task snapshots and the history is in the comment trail. Outside follow-up filed: LIN-4287.

parent.title: The shared fake DOM becomes the one in fact: move the hand-written client test fakes onto it, with a census (LIN-4252 tidy-after)

comments.body: LIN-4266 merged (PR #2299, `56f9b474`). Its gate statement recommends continuing the prompt-section family. The ticket and review say this ticket should not be dispatched as written until the parent LIN-4255 has re-planned it or explicitly accepted that recommendation. It also owns the disabled `__ai__` press witness (`prompt-section-p0.test.js:1051`, a synthetic button): keep it witnessed through the real DOM.

**Dispatch hold lifted — recording the release here, where the dispatcher reads.**

The hold in the 14:13Z comment (do not dispatch until LIN-4255 replans or explicitly accepts the probe's recommendation) is cleared. LIN-4255 carries the explicit ruling at 14:22Z ("Autopilot ruling on the prompt-section family gate"): **continue the prompt-section family as written, no re-plan**, and it releases LIN-4267, LIN-4268 and LIN-4269.

Standing instructions from that ruling for this ticket: before porting each suite, check for presses on undrawn controls and for stubs that ignore their arguments. A suite that needs an API the shared fake does not model (getBoundingClientRect, style, scroll, <select>.value) stops and is reported with the reason; it does not widen the fake. The disabled __ai__ press witness in prompt-section-p0.test.js stays witnessed through the real DOM. Moved suites leave HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES and join the fake-dom.js header consumer list (LIN-4255 move-rule wording, 13:25Z).

Dispatching the implementation step now.

LIN-4267 PR is up and CI is green: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2305

Head: b89e424a7e9ec8d382bed76fd8b38a11ae190f7d
CI run: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/actions/runs/42056839523 (completed, success)
- Unit tests: success
- E2E shards 1/4 to 4/4: success
- Secret scan (source): success
- CI success (aggregate): success

What it does: the three prompt-section suites (p0 58, run-quota 14, runner-link 13; names and counts unchanged) move from the hand-written fake DOM onto loadWorld. public/ is untouched (git diff 473cc865 HEAD -- public is empty). Each suite has an assertion map, and every replacement has a mutation with the failing tests named in the PR body. The disclosure is production's own renderDispatchDisclosure via a new test helper (tests/unit/helpers/real-dispatch-disclosure.js), not the fake.

Census: the combined ratchet is 55 -> 44 on main-merged history (LIN-4268 and LIN-4280 moved eight more on main; this PR moves its three). The branch was merged with main twice to resolve census and header conflicts.

Local evidence on b89e424a: full unit suite 23,744 pass / 0 fail; census, fake-DOM, client-world and the prompt-section suites pass.

Honest gaps (in the PR body): the run-step restore case is green under the restore mutations because the ladder repaints on re-read (only the Dispatch case guards the restore); the reader stubs remain because production's reader reads <select>.value.

Remaining close-out is for review and LIN-4272. Issue stays In Progress.

## Review — LIN-4267

PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2305, head `b89e424a7e9ec8d382bed76fd8b38a11ae190f7d` (merged with main at `aeb9d877`).

CI: green on b89e424a (run 42056839523: Unit tests, E2E 1–4/4, Secret scan, CI success all pass).

### What I checked myself
- **Scope matches the plan.** 6 test files changed, `public/` untouched. The three files leave `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` and join the `fake-dom.js` header consumer list. No `_clickHandler`, `fullRenders`, `_html`, `isCardPanel`, `findElement` or `node:vm` is left in the three suites. The leftover `makeContainer()` in p0 and runner-link is a one-line wrapper over `currentWorld.makeContainer()`.
- **Names and counts.** I re-ran `node --test --test-reporter=spec` on each suite on origin/main and on the head, with timings stripped. All three diffs are empty: p0 58, run-quota 14, runner-link 13, all passing. The census, fake-dom and client-world tests pass (133/133).
- **Mutations I re-ran myself** (all reverted; `public/` is clean afterwards):
  - M7 (`if (btn.disabled) return;` removed): p0 F9 "unconfigured … a click spends nothing" goes red. The disabled `__ai__` witness holds through the real DOM.
  - MQ2/R7 (`btn.closest('.swipe-prompt-options')` → `null` at `:2714`): run-quota "a Dispatch-panel dispatch press …" and runner-link "the disclosure's dispatch button is unchanged …" each go red.
  - A1 (label not restored in the 2s timer): only the Dispatch case goes red, as the PR's gap note says.
- **Regression and staleness.** Since the ticket was created, the files it touches have changed only through the sibling fake-DOM moves (LIN-4268/4279/4280), and the branch has merged all of them. Nothing previously fixed is reverted.
- **Findings classified.** The PR records: test-only presses on undrawn controls, a vacuous proxy-block test (now with real preconditions), and an ambiguous `data-action="setup"`. It found no client bugs and needed no API stops. That matches what I see.

### Finding: the run-step restore check was loosened (inside: this ticket's "never loosen an assertion" rule)
The old test asserted the restore on the **pressed** button (`btn.textContent === 'label'`, `btn.disabled === false`). For the run-step case the port moved those asserts to a **re-queried** node (`after`). The ladder repaints that node on the re-read, so A1/A2 stay green. The PR files this as a gap, but it is closeable. The production timer writes to the pressed `btn`, which the test still holds.

I probed it with a temporary copy (deleted afterwards). Two asserts on the pressed node, added straight after `await m.runTimers();`, pass unmutated, and turn **both** cases red under A1 and under A2 (12 pass / 2 fail each).

**Fix for close-out:** in `tests/unit/prompt-section-run-quota.test.js`, inside the `for (const [name, dataset, …])` test, straight after `await m.runTimers();` (line 272), add:
```js
assert.equal(btn.textContent, label, 'the restore puts the label back on the pressed control');
assert.equal(btn.disabled, false, 'the restore lifts the guard on the pressed control');
```
Keep the existing `after` asserts, which check what is drawn after the re-read. Then update the PR body: change the A1/A2 rows to "2 red (both cases)" and remove the first "Gaps" bullet.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Inside** (the LIN-4255 move rule: never loosen an assertion that reads fake internals; map it to a real-DOM replacement that goes red under its mutation). The run-step restore assertion is not guarded by A1/A2 at head. **Before the merge:** make the two-line fix above. Then run `node --test tests/unit/prompt-section-run-quota.test.js` with the label restore removed from the `setTimeout` (`btn.textContent = originalText;` at ~`prompt-section.js:2760`): "a run-step press makes no whole-container write …" must go red, not only the Dispatch case. Revert, confirm 14/14 green, and confirm the spec diff against main is still empty.
- **Outside** (a different problem: possible dead code in production). The standard `__autopilot__` handler branches (`public/prompt-section.js` ~2090, 2118, 2532) are drawn by no state; only `__autopilot_stepper__` is drawn. Close-out files it, after checking it does not already exist, as "standard `__autopilot__` entry is unreachable from the UI: remove it or draw it". The ported p0 tests now press the stepper, which runs the same `source`/save/copy code.

The reader stubs (`readDispatchExecControls`, which reads `<select>.value`) are not a new gap: they were stubs before the port too, and the real reader is exercised by the LIN-3833/3975/4040 suites. No ledger item.

### Verdict
Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger. The move is complete, the names and counts are unchanged and verified, the mutations hold, and CI is green. One restore assertion was moved off the pressed node, and a named two-line test fix restores it.

## Close-out — LIN-4267 (in progress, NOT merged)

**State:** PR #2305 is open and not merged. The ticket stays In Progress.

**Done**
- Review's inside fix is committed as `24150daa`, pushed, and answers the review's "run-step restore check was loosened" finding. In `tests/unit/prompt-section-run-quota.test.js`, straight after `await m.runTimers();`, it asserts the label and `disabled` on the pressed button. The existing `after` asserts are kept.
- Evidence for the fix:
  - Unmutated, the suite is 14/14.
  - A1 (label restore removed at `prompt-section.js:2760`) gives 12 pass / 2 fail.
  - A2 (guard lift removed at `:2761`) gives 12 pass / 2 fail.
  - Both cases go red under each mutation. I reverted both mutations, `public/` is clean, and the suite is back to 14/14.
  - The spec output against main, with timings stripped, has an empty diff (16 lines each).
- The PR body is updated: the A1/A2 rows now read "2 red (both cases)" and the run-step gap bullet is removed.
- CI on `24150daa` was green: Unit tests, E2E 1–4/4, Secret scan and CI success all passed (run 42059586336).

**Blocked**
- Main moved with LIN-4269 (`069585bb`), so the PR now reports CONFLICTING. The only conflict is the consumer-list comment in `tests/unit/helpers/fake-dom.js`.
- I resolved it by merging both lists and committed the merge locally as `16f31604`. The census, fake-dom, client-world and the three prompt-section suites pass locally (218/218).
- I could not push it. The push is rejected twice with `remote rejected … fatal error in commit_refs_rules`. The remote branch is still at `24150daa`.
- I did not route around the rejection (update-branch API, another branch), because I don't know what the ref rule is.

**Next action:** someone with repo admin access checks the ref-rule failure on that branch, or retries the push. Then CI must be green on the new head, and the PR gets merged pinned to that commit with `--match-head-commit`.

**Not yet done (all of it waits on the merge):** merge, Done, description prune and snapshot, and the outside follow-up. The follow-up is the unreachable standard `__autopilot__` handler (`public/prompt-section.js` ~2090, 2118, 2532). I have not searched for an existing ticket.

## Unblocked — LIN-4267: the push now lands, PR #2305 is CLEAN, CI is green

**What the blocker was.** The 16:04Z close-out could not push the merge commit `16f31604`. The rejection read `remote rejected … fatal error in commit_refs_rules`. This was **not a repo rule**, and the push now succeeds:
- The repo has exactly one ruleset, `main-protection` (id 17491666). It targets only `~DEFAULT_BRANCH`, with rules non_fast_forward, pull_request, required_status_checks and deletion.
- `GET /rules/branches/feat/lin-4267-…-loadworld` returns `[]`, so no rule applies to the feature branch.
- The text "fatal error in …" is GitHub's wording for an error inside its own rule evaluator, not a policy refusal. So it was a transient server-side failure, and a plain retry was the right fix. No bypass, no other branch, no update-branch API.

**What I did.**
- `16f31604` lived only in the other session's workspace and could not be recovered here. I redid the same merge from the remote branch head `24150daa`: `git merge origin/main` (`069585bb`, LIN-4269).
- Only one file conflicted, the consumer-list comment in `tests/unit/helpers/fake-dom.js`. I resolved it by taking the union: main's LIN-4269 entries plus this PR's three files (LIN-4267). `fake-dom-census.test.js` auto-merged, and against main its diff is exactly the removal of the three prompt-section files from `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES`.
- New head: **`6d91a37c13ef404fdad8400bff413028815a4fb8`**. It contains the review fix `24150daa`, which asserts the run-step restore on the pressed control.

**Evidence on `6d91a37c`.**
- Pushed normally: `24150daa..6d91a37c`.
- CI run 42061354243 succeeded: Unit tests, E2E 1–4/4, Secret scan and CI success all passed. https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/actions/runs/42061354243
- PR #2305 reports `mergeable: MERGEABLE`, `mergeStateStatus: CLEAN`.
- Full unit suite run locally: **23,744 pass / 0 fail**.
- Census, fake-dom, client-world and the three prompt-section suites: 218/218.
- Spec output against origin/main `069585bb`, timings stripped: **empty diff** for all three suites (p0 58/58, run-quota 14/14, runner-link 13/13).

**Ledger status, for close-out (not discharged here).**
- *Inside*: the run-step restore fix is `24150daa`, and the head carries it. The evidence is in the 16:04Z comment: A1 and A2 each give 12 pass / 2 fail.
- *Outside*: the unreachable standard `__autopilot__` handler. **No ticket tracks it yet.** I searched for `__autopilot__`, "autopilot handler unreachable" and "unreachable autopilot entry". It appears only as an input note in LIN-4272's description. I re-checked at HEAD: `public/prompt-section.js` draws only `data-prompt="__autopilot_stepper__"` (`:493`), while `__autopilot__` branches remain at `:2090`, `:2118` and `:2532`, and no other file under `public/` references it. Close-out should file it as the review worded it.

**Next action:** dispatch **close-out**. It should file the outside follow-up, merge #2305 pinned with `--match-head-commit 6d91a37c13ef404fdad8400bff413028815a4fb8`, set Done, then prune and snapshot the description. Nothing here needs the human. Per the manual, merge and Done belong to the close-out step, so I left them for it.

**Relations.** The real dependency is already recorded: LIN-4267 **blocks** LIN-4272. There was no external blocking issue to add, because the stall was a transient GitHub error and not a dependency.

## Close-out — LIN-4267

**Merged.** PR #2305 https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2305 squash-merged as `d537cd695f199fe0d500a9a086ef3cb3e25e60c9`, with `--match-head-commit 6d91a37c13ef404fdad8400bff413028815a4fb8`. A fresh read just before the merge showed `CLEAN`, with CI green on that exact commit (run 42061354243: Unit tests, E2E 1–4/4, Secret scan, CI success all SUCCESS). Review verdict was Approve with a ledger; that is the authority used.

**Changes made after approval** (none by me in this session; all were made in the earlier close-out sessions and are carried by the merged head):
- `24150daa`: answers the review finding "the run-step restore check was loosened". In `tests/unit/prompt-section-run-quota.test.js`, straight after `await m.runTimers();`, it asserts the label and `disabled` on the pressed button. The existing `after` asserts are kept. The PR body was updated (A1/A2 rows read "2 red (both cases)", the gap bullet removed).
- `6d91a37c`: merge of main (`069585bb`, LIN-4269). One conflict, in the `fake-dom.js` header consumer list, resolved by taking the union. The earlier push failure (`fatal error in commit_refs_rules`) was a transient GitHub-side error; a plain retry worked, with no bypass.

**Ledger**
- *Inside — run-step restore assertion not guarded by A1/A2:* settled by `24150daa`. Evidence recorded on the 16:04Z comment: unmutated 14/14; A1 (label restore removed, `prompt-section.js:2760`) 12 pass / 2 fail; A2 (guard lift removed, `:2761`) 12 pass / 2 fail; both reverted, `public/` clean, 14/14, spec diff against main empty. I did not re-run these mutations in this session. I did confirm on merged main that the new assertion is present, that the three suites are no longer in `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES`, and that no `public/` file differs between the head and the merge.
- *Outside — standard `__autopilot__` handler unreachable:* no existing ticket (searched `__autopilot__`, autopilot_stepper, "standard autopilot entry"; LIN-4272 only mentions it as an input note). Filed as **LIN-4287** (priority Low, since nothing user-visible breaks; labels Improvement and kind:follow-up), related to LIN-4267.
- *Named monitor / rollback:* review named none; the ledger has none.

**Deploy / post-deploy.** The change is tests-only: `public/` is untouched, so there is no production deploy surface and no post-deploy step. Verified on what landed (merge commit `d537cd69`): census no longer lists the three files, the restore assertion is on main, and no `public/` files changed. The `Tests` run on main for `d537cd69` was still queued when I checked; I did not wait for it. The same commit content passed CI on the PR head.

**Final CI state:** green on `6d91a37c` (the merged head). Previously-run local evidence: full unit suite 23,744 pass / 0 fail; spec diffs for all three suites empty.

**Housekeeping.** LIN-4267 set to Done. Pre-close-out description archived (snapshot `dfa6438f…`, captured 16:16:55Z, verified via `/snapshots`). There were no embedded plan or research sections to prune (the plan lives in LIN-4255), so I appended an "Implemented" stub and left the rest as is. LIN-4272 (blocked by this ticket) is now unblocked and stays Todo for its own close-out; no related ticket was closed.
